The Cup to Panathinaikos with a buzzer beater by Vagiannidis The Greens had a great run that was full of suspense but also great and unforgettable qualifiers on the way to the final and an epic finale at Panthessaliko Stadium. In the round of 16, Panathinaikos beat Olympiacos at Karaiskakis Stadium in the penalty shootout, while in the quarter finals, qualification came against Atromitos at Peristeri with a goal from Mladenovic in the final minutes. In the semi final, the Greens also beat PAOK on penalties after a thrilling game. And in the final, Giorgos Vagiannidis scored the winning goal in
Panathinaikos – Aris 1-0 (90+7′ Vagiannidis)
Further to the three goals scored, the team coached by Juan Ramon Rocha, had also a ball to the post, by Krzysztof Warzycha, at the 74th minute of the game!
PANATHINAIKOS: Wanchik, Apostolakis, Markos, G. Ch. Georgiadis, Kalitzakis, Kolitsidakis, Boreli, G.S. Georgiadis, Warzycha, Maragkos (74′ Kapouranis), Alexoudis.
